title: Targets
description: What a case's answer is held to: targets per kind, with the old chatddx's target kinds (7893656, src/chatddx/repo/entities/case/pydantic.py), and clinicians' notes on the case. Hand-written for the sample data.

warning.description: The acute warning the answer should raise, or false where the case calls for none.

dont_miss.description: A diagnosis the answer mustn't miss: the dangerous one, which may not be the likeliest.

notes.description: Clinicians' notes on the case, for judges: each as its author wrote it, in its language.

target.description: A target in plain words, for people and judges, and as a word pattern, for the pattern scorers; at least one of the two.

pattern.description: Words joined by & (and) and | (or), with parentheses; a trailing * matches any ending.

language.description: The note's language, as a BCP 47 tag.

comment.description: The clinician's reading of the case and what to do.

answer.description: The answer the clinician would want, in short.
